MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it works with Alexa and connects with my earlier interest in home security alarms.",
    "The Alexa devices fit my recent purchases, and the smaller SanDisk cards connect with my past use of removable storage, even though neither creates an immediate need to buy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Dot, an older Fire TV Stick, or another Echo display would repeat functions covered by my recent Dot, Fire TV Stick 4K Max, and Show 5 purchases.",
    "The AirPods do not connect clearly to my current home setup needs, and having bought storage before does not mean I currently need a 512GB card.",
    "The whole-home camera bundle feels like too large a commitment when I would prefer to try a single doorbell first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Alexa purchases seem to be treated as a reason to buy more speakers and displays, even when I already have those functions covered.",
    "My older storage purchases seem to imply a continuing need for memory cards without a specific device or capacity requirement."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases matter because they can satisfy a need: the Show 5 stand suggests I am building around that display rather than seeking another one.",
    "I am more interested in adding a useful capability to my existing setup, such as a doorbell, than buying another version of something I recently acquired.",
    "Interest in Alexa-controlled lighting does not necessarily mean I need the additional speaker bundled with it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics but often confuse an existing interest with an unmet need."
}
